results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the campaign identifier and whether “details” means configuration, performance, or both; for METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS choose exactly one window method (date_preset OR time_range).
[Optional (if access scope is unclear)] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate accessible ad accounts using METAADS_GET_AD_ACCOUNTS (follow paging cursors/next) to confirm the campaign is in-scope.
[Required] [Step]: Fetch campaign configuration and delivery context using METAADS_GET_OBJECT (minimal fields such as status/effective_status/objective/budget-related fields/start-stop/buying_type).

[Required (if performance is requested)] [Step]: Retrieve campaign KPIs using METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS at level="campaign" (request only needed metrics; include actions/action_values only when lead/conversion detail is required).

[Optional (if lead/conversion counts are required)] [Next Step]: Derive lead-related totals from METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS by scanning the actions array for relevant action_type values (don’t assume a single fixed key).

[Required] [Next Step]: If METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS returns paging (paging.cursors.after or paging.next), request subsequent pages and aggregate rows; if breakdowns are used, roll totals up to avoid double counting.

[Optional (if delivery debugging or inventory is needed)] [Next Step]: Inspect structure using METAADS_READ_ADSETS and METAADS_LIST_ADS; corroborate assets with METAADS_LIST_AD_CREATIVES when ads appear missing or mismatched.
[Fallback (if insights are empty or error)] [Fallback]: Re-check dates/config via METAADS_GET_OBJECT and re-run METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS with a reporting window aligned to the campaign’s active period.
known_pitfalls: [METAADS_GET_OBJECT] 401 OAuthException code 190 with subcode 463 indicates an expired token/session; re-auth then retry.
[METAADS_GET_OBJECT] GraphMethodException code 100 with subcode 33 commonly indicates an invalid/inaccessible campaign identifier or missing permissions.
[METAADS_GET_OBJECT] Successful responses may omit requested fields (e.g., budget fields when budgeting is set lower in the hierarchy); treat missing keys as “not set”.
[METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS] Metrics such as spend/clicks/impressions are often returned as strings; cast before computing derived values.
[METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS] action metrics are arrays of objects (actions/action_values) and may include extra attribution-window keys; parse defensively by action_type.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Parse insights rows and extract nested actions/action_values by action_type for derived KPIs.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
rows=[]
for r in insights_rows:
    spend=float(r.get('spend',0) or 0)
    purchases=sum(float(a.get('value',0) or 0) for a in (r.get('actions') or []) if a.get('action_type')=='purchase')
    value=sum(float(a.get('value',0) or 0) for a in (r.get('action_values') or []) if a.get('action_type')=='purchase')
    roas=(value/spend) if spend else 0
    rows.append((r.get('campaign_id'), spend, purchases, value, roas))
```

METAADS_GET_OBJECT.description: Tool to retrieve data for any Meta Marketing API object by its ID. Use when you need to get information about a specific ad account, campaign, ad set, ad, ad creative, page, user, or other Meta object. Supports flexible field selection to retrieve only the data you need.

fields.description: List of specific fields to retrieve from the object. If not specified, only basic fields (id, name) will be returned. Available fields depend on the object type. Common fields include: id, name, status, account_id, created_time, updated_time. For ads: campaign_id, adset_id, creative. For campaigns: objective, buying_type, daily_budget. For ad creatives: asset_feed_spec, object_story_spec, image_url, video_id, title, body, link_url, call_to_action_type. For users: email, first_name, last_name. Note: For ad account objects, use 'ad_account_promotable_objects' to retrieve promotable objects - the field name 'promotable_objects' (without prefix) is not valid for ad accounts.

object_id.description: The numeric ID of the Facebook Graph API object (e.g., '123456789012345'). Must be a numeric Facebook ID, not an image hash or other non-numeric identifier. Can be an ad account ID (with or without 'act_' prefix), campaign ID, ad set ID, ad ID, ad creative ID, page ID, user ID, or any other Meta Marketing API object ID. For user info, use 'me' as the object_id.

time_range.description: Custom date range for aggregating insights metrics.

date_preset.description: Predefined date range options for aggregating insights metrics.

updated_since.description: Unix timestamp to retrieve only objects updated since this time. Useful for incremental syncs and fetching recent changes.

METAADS_GET_AD_ACCOUNTS.description: Tool to retrieve all ad account IDs accessible to the authenticated user from Meta Ads. Use when you need to get a user's ad account information including account IDs, names, and other account details.

limit.description: Maximum number of ad accounts to return (default 25)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Common fields: id, name, account_id, currency, timezone_name, account_status, business_name, business. The 'id' field returns the ad account ID prefixed with 'act_', while 'account_id' returns the numeric ID without prefix.

METAADS_READ_ADSETS.description: Retrieve ad sets from a Meta ad account using the Marketing API. Returns information about the ad sets including their status, targeting, and other properties.

limit.description: Maximum number of adsets to return

items.description: Valid fields that can be requested for an AdSet from Meta's Marketing API.

fields.description: Fields to return for each ad set. Select from the AdSetField enum values (e.g., name, id, status, daily_budget, targeting, campaign_id, effective_status). Defaults to name, id, and status if not specified.

date_preset.description: Predefined date range used to aggregate insights metrics. Values are case-insensitive (e.g., 'this_year' or 'THIS_YEAR').

ad_account_id.description: ID of the ad account to fetch adsets from

updated_since.description: Time since the Adset has been updated (in seconds)

effective_status.description: Filter adsets by their effective status. Values are case-insensitive (e.g., 'active' or 'ACTIVE').

time_range_since.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format for custom date range

time_range_until.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format for custom date range
